```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "Europe/Paris"))
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)

meteo_station <- function(station_id = "07156",
                          from = Sys.Date() - days(1),
                          to   = Sys.Date()) {

  tibble(date = seq.Date(from = from, to = to, by = "day")) %>%
    
    mutate(
      url = paste0(
        "https://www.meteo60.fr/stations-releves/station-jour-csv?station_id=-",
        station_id,
        "&date=",
        format(date, "%d/%m/%Y")
      )
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(data = purrr::map(url, readr::read_delim, show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
    
    mutate(data = purrr::map(data, \(df) {
      df$Vent_moyen <- as.character(df$Vent_moyen)
      df
    })) %>%
    
    unnest(data) %>%
    select(-url, -...15) %>%
    arrange(desc(date), desc(Heure_UTC)) %>%
    
    relocate(date, .after = last_col()) %>%
    relocate(Heure_UTC, .after = last_col()) %>%
    
    select(
      Heure_legale,
      Temperature,
      Temps,
      Vent_moyen,
      Humidite_relative,
      everything()
    ) %>%
    
    gt() |>
    
    cols_width(
      1:2 ~ gt::px(70),
      3   ~ gt::px(150),
      4   ~ gt::px(80),
      everything() ~ gt::px(100)
    ) |>
    
    opt_interactive(
      use_search = FALSE,
      use_pagination = FALSE,
      use_pagination_info = FALSE,
      use_compact_mode = TRUE
    ) |>
    
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = gt::md(
        paste0(
          "Date : ",
          format(Sys.time(), "%A %d %B %Y, %Hh%M"),
          ". Source : https://www.infoclimat.fr/observations-meteo/temps-reel/",
          station_id,
          ".html"
        )
      )
    ) |>
    
    tab_options(table.width = "100%")
}

meteo_station_last_days <- function(station_id = "07156",
                                    n_days = 30,
                                    as_gt = TRUE) {

  stopifnot(n_days > 0)

  today <- Sys.Date()
  start_date <- today - n_days + 1

  # mois nécessaires pour couvrir la période
  months_needed <- seq(floor_date(start_date, "month"),
                       floor_date(today, "month"),
                       by = "1 month")

  data <- purrr::map_dfr(months_needed, \(d) {

    url <- paste0(
      "https://www.meteo60.fr/stations-releves/station-mois-csv?station_id=",
      station_id,
      "&mois=", month(d),
      "&annee=", year(d) - 2000
    )

    read_delim(url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      select(-7) %>%
      mutate(
        jour = parse_number(Jour),
        date = as.Date(ISOdate(year(d), month(d), jour))
      )
  }) %>%
    filter(date >= start_date & date <= today) %>%
    arrange(desc(date)) %>%
    select(date, Jour, everything(), -jour)

  if (!as_gt) return(data)

  data %>%
    gt() |>
    opt_interactive(
      use_search = FALSE,
      use_pagination = FALSE,
      use_pagination_info = FALSE,
      use_compact_mode = TRUE
    ) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = gt::md(
        paste0(
          n_days, " derniers jours. Généré le ",
          format(Sys.time(), "%A %d %B %Y, %Hh%M"),
          ". Source : https://www.meteo60.fr/"
        )
      )
    ) |>
    tab_options(table.width = "100%")
}

meteo_station("07156", from = Sys.Date() - 2)
```



## 30 derniers jours

```{r echo = F, message = F, warning = F}
meteo_station_last_days("07156", 30)
```
